sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant UI as "Management Form"
    participant System as "Item Controller"
    participant DB as "ENTITY_ITEM"
    User->>UI: Input Item Details
    UI->>System: Request Create/Update
    System->>System: Validate (CONSTR_ITEM_PRICE, CONSTR_ITEM_NAME)
    alt is Valid
        System->>DB: Persist Data
        DB-->>System: Success
        System-->>UI: Display Success
        UI-->>User: Item Updated/Created
    else is Invalid
        System-->>UI: Return Validation Error
        UI-->>User: Prompt Correction
    end
    User->>UI: Toggle Availability
    UI->>System: Request Toggle (REQ_ITEM_TOGGLE)
    System->>DB: Update availability boolean
    DB-->>System: Success
    System-->>UI: Update Status
    UI-->>User: Availability Changed
